body:
I'll start by exploring the repository structure, style guide, and available sources in parallel.

Now let me read the verifier to understand exact constraints, and explore the source pages.

Let me read the full verifier to understand exact fence/citation rules.

I now understand the contract. Let me gather exact citation anchors across the key sources in parallel.

Let me read the exact content of the key `podman-run` ranges.

Now let me gather resource limits, inspect formats, and other command anchors.

Let me gather network, volume, secret, pod, and config-path anchors.

Let me gather the final set of anchors: rootless, storage/registries config, healthcheck, inspect examples, and `latest` semantics.

Let me gather final anchors for build squash, healthcheck line numbers, compose env, and quadlet paths.

I have enough anchors. Let me verify exact verbatim text for the few fences I'll quote directly.

All anchors verified. Now writing chapter 24.

Now chapter 25.

I spotted two errors in chapter 25 (an out-of-range citation and a stray non-English word). Fixing them now.

Now let me gather quick-reference command anchors efficiently.

Now writing chapter 26, the quick reference.

Let me audit my three files for shape, line counts, and any remaining out-of-range citations.

Final manual audit of all citation ranges and fence structure (read-only, not the verifier).

Let me verify the fence head lines and bodies exactly.

Critical: the fence heads appear blank. Let me inspect the surrounding lines.

Found the issue: blank lines between citation heads and fences. Removing them across all three files.

Let me add the explicit compact `derived` checklist required for chapter 24.

One last check that all `inspect --format` keys I used are documented.

Completed all three assigned chapters in `runtimes/podman_guide/`:

- **`24-determinism-playbook.md`** (230 lines) — ordered production procedure: digest/no-`latest` + pull-policy matrix, policy/signature/SBOM validation, versioned `containers.conf`/`storage.conf`/`registries.conf`/`policy.json`, fixed networks/volumes/secrets, `keep-id`+`--user`, bounded logs and single-authority health/restart, explicit resource limits, compose provider pinning vs Quadlet/kube, `inspect --format`/`healthcheck run` gates, and a six-step rollback plan. Includes an explicit compact `derived` checklist with per-item citations.
- **`25-decisions-and-pitfalls.md`** (158 lines) — 14 trade-off tables covering every assigned decision (rootless/rootful, `keep-id`/`nomap`, bind/volume, `:z`/`:Z`, journald/k8s-file, compose/kube/Quadlet, `--layers`/squash, pull policies, signing types, netavark/CNI, socket/TCP, machine/native) plus 16 concrete anti-patterns with consequences.
- **`26-quick-reference.md`** (182 lines) — commands grouped by object (container/image/pod/network/volume/secret/machine/system/kube/compose/quadlet), global flags, env vars, root/rootless config paths, memorizable defaults, and output-format/exit-check tables.

Manual audit (without running `verify.py`, per assignment): correct first-line headings and final `## Pitfalls`/`## Sources` in each; 120–240 line target met; every citation token points to an existing file with an in-range line span; every fence has a non-blank head with exactly one source token (or `derived`), a language tag, ≤25 verbatim lines. Fixed three issues found during the audit: an out-of-range `podman.1.md` citation, a wrong `--privileged` line reference, and blank lines separating citation heads from fences.
